digest.component_or_area: LLM model class configuration and sub-call routing
propositions: Four hand-built RunRequest sites bypass model-class configuration by passing raw cfg without specifying a model class, causing calls to inherit cfg.model instead of honoring class-based routing.

overlap-judge dominates plan-review traffic at 18 of 23 LLM calls and routes to direct Anthropic when classes are configured on Bedrock, leaving the majority of gate traffic on the unintended provider.

ticket-digest runs on the store write path (enrich_drain from event_append and push) sending ticket content to direct Anthropic during routine rebar comment/create operations with no visibility in verdict output.

Fixing requires each of the three sub-call sites (ticket-digest, overlap-judge, code-novelty) to explicitly select from the class vocabulary (trivial, standard, or frontier) rather than inherit cfg.model, with explicit reasoning at each site.

A general provenance guard that traces config= expressions in every RunRequest across src/rebar must detect and fail if any hand-built sub-call inherits raw cfg.model while a class table is configured, preventing silent reintroduction.

Regression test must construct the overlap-judge trigger deliberately via candidate retrieval (wire.py only runs judge when BM25F returns candidates) rather than relying on running a gate and hoping the judge fires.
